title: The Equinox 2.0 - Overview & General Information

metadata.venue: Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship, MLR Institute of Technology, Dundigal Police Station Road, Hyderabad – 500 043, Telangana, India

content:
The Equinox 2.0 (2026) is the flagship annual entrepreneurship summit organized by the Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (CIE) at MLR Institute of Technology (MLRIT), Hyderabad.
Tagline: "Where Passion Meets Perseverance" (# WHERE PASSION MEETS PERSEVERANCE).
Dates: 30th & 31st October 2026 (30th & 31st October 2026).
Venue: Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship, MLR Institute of Technology, Dundigal Police Station Road, Hyderabad – 500 043, Telangana, India.
Host: Centre for Innovation & Entrepreneurship (CIE), MLRIT. Institution: MLRIT ("Engineering Ideas, Engineering Careers").
Audience: Over 1,000+ student innovators, builders, startup founders, strategists, and E-Cell leaders across campuses in India.
Highlights: 10 official sub-events, 2 action-packed days, 50+ college E-Cells participating.

title: Who We Are & What We Do - CIE MLRIT
content:
Who Are We:
Established in 2015, MLRIT-CIE is an entrepreneurship development cell dedicated to nurturing young innovators and supporting early-stage startups. We focus on building a strong and thriving ecosystem that encourages growth, collaboration, and innovation. By inspiring creativity and entrepreneurial spirit among students, alumni, faculty, and industry partners, we create opportunities for learning, development, and success. Through continuous support and guidance, we aim to drive innovation and turn ideas into reality.

What We Do:
We host high-impact hackathons, from MetaLoop, our biggest national-level AR/VR hackathon, to Inventron, our flagship 36-hour build challenge.

What Is Equinox:
Equinox is an entrepreneurship summit organized by the Centre for Innovation and Entrepreneurship at MLR Institute of Technology, Hyderabad. It pictures a vibrant and engaging environment where students tackle real-world challenges and ignite their entrepreneurial spirit through sub-events Spotlight, Crossroads, Startup Expo, Brand Battles, IPL Auction, Hustle Mania, Internship Drive, Startup Poly, E-Cell Meet, and Pitch Deck.
The Equinox is designed to test grit, sharp business acumen, street hustle, and visionary thinking. Across two high-voltage days on 30 - 31 October at MLRIT Hyderabad, participants dive into 10 premier sub-events ranging from simulated live cricket bidding and Monopoly-style business conquer to high-stakes investor pitch decks. Whether you're marketing products on campus in Hustle Mania, dissecting corporate dilemmas in Crossroads, or defending your favourite enterprise in Brand Battles, Equinox is where collegiate passion transforms into real-world perseverance.

title: Sub-Event: Spotlight (Page 05)
content:
Sub-Event Name: Spotlight
Brochure Page: Page 05
Category: Keynote & Insights
Tagline: "Visionary Keynotes & Emerging Tech Insights"
Description: Spotlight is an interactive session that brings students closer to entrepreneurs, industry professionals, and thought leaders. The event creates a platform for meaningful conversations about business, innovation, technology, leadership, and professional growth. Participants get the opportunity to hear about real experiences, understand the challenges faced by industry professionals, and explore how ideas develop into practical ventures. Through engaging discussions and personal insights, the session encourages curiosity and provides a broader understanding of the entrepreneurial and professional world. Whether you're interested in entrepreneurship, career development, or emerging industry trends, Spotlight offers an opportunity to learn from experienced individuals and gain perspectives that extend beyond the classroom.

Format:
Expert keynote presentations followed by interactive audience Q&A

Detailed Overview:
Featuring inspiring presentations from industry experts on the latest trends in technology and entrepreneurship, the e-Summit will provide attendees with valuable insights into emerging technologies, industry trends, and the future of work.
These talks will not only inform but also motivate and inspire, as participants hear firsthand how successful entrepreneurs overcame challenges and built thriving ventures. The personal stories of resilience and innovation will empower attendees to pursue their own ambitions with renewed determination, helping them stay focused and driven in the long run.

Target Skills: Tech Trends Analysis, Strategic Foresight, Startup Insights, Networking
Eligibility: Open to all summit attendees
Team Size: Individual or open entry
Schedule & Timing: 30 - 31 Oct (Sessions across both days) (Day 1 & 2 (30–31 Oct), Sessions on both days)
Venue: Main Auditorium, MLRIT

Fees: Free with summit pass
Prizes & Perks: Exclusive mentor connections

2. Audience Q&A follows each keynote session
3. Priority seating for early arrivals

title: Sub-Event: Cross Roads (Page 05)
content:
Sub-Event Name: Cross Roads
Brochure Page: Page 05
Category: Case Competition
Tagline: "Business Case-Study Strategy Challenge"
Description: Crossroads is a business case-study competition that places participants in real-world business situations. Teams step into the roles of decision-makers and work together to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and develop practical strategies. Participants may take on roles such as CEO, CTO, Marketing Manager, or Finance Head, allowing them to examine a business problem from different perspectives. Each team must analyse the given situation, evaluate possible approaches, and prepare a solution that addresses the central challenge. The competition concludes with teams presenting their strategies and defending their decisions. Through this experience, participants explore the complexities of business management, teamwork, and strategic thinking in a competitive environment.

Format:
Team case challenge: problem breakdown, strategy formulation & jury defense

Detailed Overview:
An interactive business simulation where each team member will take on a specific role, such as CEO, CTO, or Marketing Manager. They will face a challenging scenario and will be tasked with developing a strategic plan to overcome the obstacles.
The top three teams will be awarded prizes for their exceptional performance based on creativity, feasibility, and teamwork.

Target Skills: Case Analysis, Strategic Problem Solving, Risk Management, Business Strategy
Eligibility: Teams of 4–5 students from any branch or college
Team Size: Teams of 4–5
Schedule & Timing: 30 Oct (10:00 AM - 04:00 PM) (Day 1 & 2 (30–31 Oct), 10:00 AM - 04:00 PM)
Venue: CIE Seminar Hall B
Registration Status: Register Now
Fees: Included in ₹869 summit pass
Prizes & Perks: Exciting awards & certificates

Rules & Guidelines:
1. Teams of 4 to 5 students
2. Case dossier provided on event morning
3. Presentation deck submission within 3 hours
4. 7-min presentation + 3-min judge questions

title: Sub-Event: Brand Battles (Page 05)
content:
Sub-Event Name: Brand Battles
Brochure Page: Page 05
Category: Competitive Debate
Tagline: "The Ultimate Rival Brand Defense Debate"
Description: Brand Battles is a competitive debate where participants represent rival brands from the same industry. Teams must defend their chosen brand by using research, relevant data, real-world examples, and well-structured arguments. The event encourages participants to examine how brands compete, communicate their value, attract customers, and establish their position in the market. Teams must understand their own brand as well as the strategies of their competitors. As the debate progresses, participants present their viewpoints, challenge opposing arguments, and respond to questions. The event combines brand analysis, business reasoning, and persuasive communication in an engaging competitive format.

Format:
Head-to-head debate rounds defending iconic market rivalries

Detailed Overview:
A competitive debate where two teams represent rival brands from the same sector. Participants present strong, well-researched arguments supported by real-time data, case studies, and relevant market examples to demonstrate why their chosen brand stands superior. Teams with the most compelling arguments and impactful presentations will be awarded.
Defend Apple vs Samsung, Swiggy vs Zomato, Coca-Cola vs Pepsi, or Nike vs Adidas in fierce knockout clash rounds.

Target Skills: Brand Strategy, Market Research, Argumentation & Rebuttal, Competitive Analysis
Eligibility: Teams of 4–5
Team Size: Teams of 4–5
Schedule & Timing: 31 Oct (11:00 AM - 03:30 PM) (Day 1 & 2 (30–31 Oct), 11:00 AM - 03:30 PM)
Venue: Conference Hall 1
Registration Status: Register Now
Fees: Included in ₹869 summit pass
Prizes & Perks: Cash prizes & trophies

Rules & Guidelines:
1. Teams of 4–5 members
2. Brands randomly paired per debate bracket
3. Strict timekeeping for arguments, cross-examination, and closing statements
4. Scoring based on data backing, poise, and logical rebuttals

title: Sub-Event: IPL Auction (Page 05)
content:
Sub-Event Name: IPL Auction
Brochure Page: Page 05
Category: Strategic Simulation
Tagline: "Simulated Cricket Bidding & Team Strategy"
Description: IPL Auction is a simulated cricket auction in which participants take on the role of franchise owners and compete to build their ideal cricket team. Each team must make careful decisions while working within a limited budget. Participants evaluate available players, decide when to place bids, and manage their finances throughout the auction. Every purchase affects the remaining budget and the team's ability to acquire other players, making planning an important part of the experience. The event combines cricket knowledge with strategic thinking, financial management, and competitive bidding. Participants must balance their preferences with their budget while working towards building a strong and well-planned squad.

Format:
Simulated live auction with virtual purse budget & squad composition rules

Detailed Overview:
The IPL Auction is a competitive cricket draft experience where participants step into the shoes of team owners and build their own squads. Just like the official auction, each team is given a fixed budget to bid on players. The event runs in a fast-paced, high-energy format as participants strategize, outbid rivals, and assemble the strongest lineup for their team.
Experience the intense rush of the auctioneer's hammer! Calculate player points, maintain purse discipline, and assemble a championship-winning playing XI.

Target Skills: Budget Allocation, Dynamic Auction Bidding, Statistical Valuation, Squad Strategy
Eligibility: Teams of 4–5
Team Size: Teams of 4–5
Schedule & Timing: 31 Oct (Auction hammer drops 10:00 AM) (Day 1 & 2 (30–31 Oct), 10:00 AM - 04:30 PM)
Venue: Indoor Sports Complex / Hall A
Registration Status: Register Now
Fees: Included in ₹869 summit pass
Prizes & Perks: Champion purse & team medals

Rules & Guidelines:
1. Teams of 4–5 participants representing a franchise
2. Equal virtual purse allocated to all teams at start
3. Mandatory player category quotas (batsmen, bowlers, all-rounders, wicketkeepers)
4. Final team score calculated using official performance ratings

title: Sub-Event: Hustle Mania (Page 06)
content:
Sub-Event Name: Hustle Mania
Brochure Page: Page 06
Category: Marketing & Sales
Tagline: "On-Ground Marketing, Selling & Negotiation"
Description: Hustle Mania is an interactive selling and marketing event where participants operate stalls and sell products of their choice. It gives students an opportunity to experience the practical side of business by engaging directly with potential customers. Participants decide how to present their products, attract attention, communicate value, and respond to customer questions. They must adjust their approach based on customer reactions while working to generate sales in a competitive environment. The event transforms selling into a hands-on experience, allowing participants to explore the realities of customer interaction, marketing, negotiation, and business communication. Every conversation becomes an opportunity to understand customer preferences and improve the selling approach.

Format:
Live on-campus selling showdown with allocated seed stock or chosen products

Detailed Overview:
Hustle Mania is a hands-on business and marketing challenge where participants set up stalls and sell their products to real customers. Every aspect of their operations — expenditure, pricing, revenue, and profit — is tracked throughout the event. Teams must apply marketing strategies, customer engagement skills, and smart budgeting to maximize performance.
Get out on the floor and prove your selling chops. Strategize product pricing, invent guerrilla marketing hooks, and maximize revenue before the closing bell.

Target Skills: Direct Selling, Persuasion & Pitching, Product Margins, Customer Psychology
Eligibility: Teams of 4–5
Team Size: Teams of 4–5
Schedule & Timing: 30 Oct (Running throughout Day 1) (Day 1 & 2 (30–31 Oct), 10:30 AM - 04:30 PM)
Venue: Campus Promenade & CIE Courtyard
Registration Status: Register Now
Fees: ₹2,999 onwards
Prizes & Perks: Retain profits + Winner Trophy

Rules & Guidelines:
1. Permitted products verified by CIE coordinators
2. Selling restricted to designated campus zones
3. Strict ethical marketing and accounting practices enforced
4. Winner decided by net margin, sales volume, and customer feedback

title: Sub-Event: Internship Drive (Page 06)
content:
Sub-Event Name: Internship Drive
Brochure Page: Page 06
Category: Career & Recruitment
Tagline: "Fast-Track Career Opportunities with Startups"
Description: Internship Drive brings students and participating startups or organisations together to explore internship and career opportunities. The event provides a platform for students to learn about different professional roles, understand workplace expectations, and interact with organisations from various industries. Participating organisations can introduce their work, explain available opportunities, and connect with students who are interested in gaining practical experience. Students can discuss potential roles, understand relevant requirements, and learn more about the skills needed in professional environments. By bringing employers and students into one space, Internship Drive encourages meaningful interaction and helps participants explore possible career directions beyond their academic studies.

Format:
On-spot resumes, screening rounds, and founder interviews

Detailed Overview:
The Internship Drive is a unique platform designed for students to connect with companies that may not traditionally engage with campus recruitment. This event provides an opportunity to explore diverse career paths while gaining valuable experience with dynamic startups and mid-level firms. Participants can enhance their professional network and acquire essential skills to thrive in today’s competitive job market.
Skip months of cold outreach. Meet hiring founders, software teams, and growth leads face-to-face for immediate internship screening.

Target Skills: Interviewing, Resume Pitching, Startup Readiness, Professional Networking

Fees: Free for summit registrants
Prizes & Perks: Paid internship offers

3. Attend pre-screening briefing at 09:30 AM

title: Sub-Event: Startup Poly (Page 06)
content:
Sub-Event Name: Startup Poly
Brochure Page: Page 06
Category: Business Gaming
Tagline: "Monopoly-Inspired Fast-Paced Business Simulation"
Description: Startup Poly is a live, startup-themed business simulation inspired by the mechanics of a board game. Teams compete to build and manage a valuable business portfolio within a fixed gameplay period. Participants begin with available funds and move across a specially designed board, where they encounter opportunities to acquire and upgrade businesses. Throughout the game, teams must manage their finances, evaluate investments, respond to changing situations, and make decisions that influence their business growth. The simulation introduces participants to business concepts through an engaging and competitive format. Instead of simply discussing entrepreneurship, teams experience the challenges of managing resources, taking risks, responding to competition, and making decisions within limited time and money.

Format:
Custom board-game business simulation with market shock cards & rounds

Detailed Overview:
Startup Poly is a Monopoly-inspired entrepreneurship challenge where participants roll a die and navigate through a board filled with startup-themed opportunities, challenges, rewards, and setbacks. Every move tests their business skills, creativity, and decision-making as they tackle real-world entrepreneurial scenarios. The participants who successfully overcome the challenges and remain in the game until the end will be declared the winners.
Navigate venture rounds, regulatory hurdles, runway burn rates, and hostile takeovers in this high-energy tabletop simulation.

Target Skills: Resource Management, Risk Assessment, Market Maneuvering, Financial Acumen
Eligibility: Teams of 4–5
Team Size: Teams of 4–5
Schedule & Timing: 30 Oct (Multi-table tournament) (Day 1 & 2 (30–31 Oct), 11:00 AM - 04:00 PM)
Venue: CIE Innovation Lounge
Registration Status: Register Now
Fees: Included in ₹869 summit pass
Prizes & Perks: Equinox Board Champion Shield

Rules & Guidelines:
1. Each table operates with standardized game rules
2. Shock cards introduce unpredictable market events every round
3. Highest venture enterprise valuation after 10 rounds advances to finals

title: Sub-Event: E-Cell Meet (Page 06)
content:
Sub-Event Name: E-Cell Meet
Brochure Page: Page 06
Category: Leadership & Networking
Tagline: "Inter-College Entrepreneurship Leaders Conclave"
Description: E-Cell Meet is an inter-college gathering that brings together entrepreneurship cells, student leaders, and innovation communities from different institutions. The event provides a space for participants to exchange experiences, discuss initiatives, and explore opportunities for collaboration. Representatives from different E-Cells can share their approaches to organising events, engaging students, supporting innovation, and promoting entrepreneurship on their campuses. The gathering encourages open discussions about common challenges and possible ways to strengthen student-led initiatives. Through conversations and networking, E-Cell Meet aims to build stronger connections between campus entrepreneurship communities and create opportunities for future partnerships and collaborative activities.

Format:
Roundtable discussions, best practice sharing, and MOU partnerships

Detailed Overview:
The E-Cell Meet is a networking event where E-Cells from different colleges come together to collaborate and share ideas. It provides a platform for students to connect, exchange experiences, and explore potential partnerships. The focus is on building relationships and fostering collaboration across campuses.
Share proven event frameworks, solve volunteer engagement challenges, and establish co-incubation and cross-promotion pacts.

Target Skills: Ecosystem Building, Cross-Campus Collaboration, Event Scaling, Leadership
Eligibility: E-Cell leaders and representatives
Team Size: 4–5 delegates per E-Cell
Schedule & Timing: 31 Oct (Afternoon conclave) (Day 2 (31 Oct), 02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)
Venue: Executive Boardroom, MLRIT
Registration Status: Register Now
Fees: Invite / Delegate pass
Prizes & Perks: Institutional collaboration MOUs

Rules & Guidelines:
1. Open to officially recognized college E-Cell leads or members
2. Participating teams present a 3-minute campus ecosystem snapshot
3. Collaborative policy resolution drafted at conclave close

title: Sub-Event: Pitch Deck (Page 06)
content:
Sub-Event Name: Pitch Deck
Brochure Page: Page 06
Category: Startup Pitching
Tagline: "Pitching Real Ventures to Investors & Mentors"
Description: Pitch Deck is a startup pitching platform where selected teams present their business ideas before investors, mentors, and industry professionals. The event gives aspiring entrepreneurs an opportunity to explain their ventures and receive feedback from experienced members of the business ecosystem. Participants present important aspects of their startup, including the problem they aim to solve, their proposed solution, target customers, business model, market opportunity, and future plans. They must communicate their ideas clearly while responding to questions from the panel. The session provides exposure to the pitching process and helps participants understand how business ideas are presented and evaluated. Through feedback and interaction with the panel, teams can gain new perspectives on their concepts and identify areas for further improvement.

Format:
5-min pitch + 5-min Q&A before angel investors and CIE mentors

Detailed Overview:
Pitch Deck is an idea presentation event where participants showcase their startup concepts to a panel of investors, venture capitalists, and industry experts. Teams present their problem statement, solution, business model, and market potential through a structured pitch. Selected ideas receive constructive feedback, mentorship opportunities, and potential support from the panel.
Step onto the main stage in front of active investors and seasoned mentors. Convince the jury of your market sizing, unit economics, and execution capability.

Target Skills: Pitch Deck Design, Financial Projections, Value Proposition, Investor Defense
Eligibility: Student founders with idea, prototype, or early traction
Team Size: Teams of 4–5 founders
Schedule & Timing: 31 Oct (Grand Finale track) (Day 1 & 2 (30–31 Oct), 10:30 AM - 04:00 PM)
Venue: Main Stage Auditorium
Registration Status: Register Now
Fees: Included in ₹869 summit pass
Prizes & Perks: Seed funding & incubation support

Rules & Guidelines:
1. Pitch deck submission (max 10 slides, PDF format) prior to the event
2. Strict 5 minutes pitch window followed by 5 minutes jury interrogation
3. Evaluated on problem severity, market size, unfair advantage, and execution clarity

title: About Equinox (Official Program Blueprint)
content:

Through sub-events Spotlight, Crossroads, Startup Expo, Brand Battles, IPL Auction, Hustle Mania, Internship Drive, E-Cell Meet, and Pitch Deck, participants gain invaluable experiences that enhance their problem-solving abilities, creativity, and entrepreneurial mindset.

title: Equinox Vision & Objectives (Official Program Blueprint)
content:

Our event empowers emerging innovators and aspiring entrepreneurs to refine their concepts, gain visibility, and explore opportunities for growth, mentorship, and collaboration.

title: E-Cell Meet - Networking for E-Cells from Different Colleges (Official Program Blueprint)
content:
SUB EVENT: E-CELL MEET (Source: equinox-events.pdf)
The E-Cell Meet is a networking event where E-Cells from different colleges come together to collaborate and share ideas. It provides a platform for students to connect, exchange experiences, and explore potential partnerships. The focus is on building relationships and fostering collaboration across campuses.

title: Pitch Deck - Presenting Startup Concepts to Investors (Official Program Blueprint)
content:
SUB EVENT: PITCH DECK (Source: equinox-events.pdf)
Pitch Deck is an idea presentation event where participants showcase their startup concepts to a panel of investors, venture capitalists, and industry experts. Teams present their problem statement, solution, business model, and market potential through a structured pitch. Selected ideas receive constructive feedback, mentorship opportunities, and potential support from the panel.

Event SPOCs (Single Points of Contact):
• Anuj Lomte: Phone +91 93901 20510

title: Registration Process & Summit Passes
content:
Registration Details for The Equinox 2.0:
Registrations for The Equinox 2.0 (30 - 31 October 2026) are now live! Secure your team spot to participate in our flagship sub-events across strategy, tech, and business.

Registration Steps:
1. Select Sub-Events: Pick from the 10 official competitions and exhibitions across tech, strategy, and business.
2. Form Your Team: Assemble your squad or enter solo depending on event criteria.
3. Submit Details: Register online or via CIE MLRIT campus desk.
4. Compete & Win: Arrive at MLRIT Hyderabad on 30 - 31 October to pitch, hustle, and conquer.

Summit Pass:
Full access pass for both days (30 - 31 October 2026).
Perks include: Access to all 10 sub-events, Startup Expo floor badge, delegate kit, participation certificates, and exclusive founder/mentor networking.
For team discounts or institutional group passes, contact student coordinators or email cie@mlrinstitutions.ac.in.

title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
content:
Frequently Asked Questions about Equinox 2.0:

Q1: When and where is The Equinox 2.0 taking place?
A1: The summit is scheduled for 30 - 31 October at MLR Institute of Technology, Dundigal Police Station Road, Hyderabad – 500 043, Telangana.

Q2: How many sub-events are part of Equinox 2.0?
A2: There are 10 confirmed sub-events: Spotlight, Crossroads, Startup Expo, Brand Battles, IPL Auction, Hustle Mania, Internship Drive, Startup Poly, E-Cell Meet, and Pitch Deck.

Q3: Who can participate in Equinox 2.0?
A3: Students from any college, department, or year can participate. Diverse events cater to strategists, coders, marketers, cricket enthusiasts, and startup founders.

Q4: How can I contact the event coordinators?
A4: You can reach Overall Equinox Coordinators Ghanashyam (+91 93900 06806), Jaikar (+91 90324 10189), or Bhavana (+91 99895 32925), or email cie@mlrinstitutions.ac.in.

Who Can Attend:
Students, innovators, developers, strategists, and aspiring startup founders from any recognized university or college across India can participate.
Events cater to diverse specializations including sales/marketing (Hustle Mania), strategy/case analysis (Crossroads), cricket strategy & finance (IPL Auction), venture pitching (Pitch Deck), tech trends (Spotlight), and gaming/monopoly simulation (Startup Poly).
